# MinGW-w64 and GCC runtime notices

The release executables statically link MinGW-w64 runtime and winpthread code,
as well as GCC runtime components pulled in by the HarfBuzz static library.
The notices in this directory are copied verbatim from the upstream projects:

- `COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt`
  - <https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/blob/master/COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime/COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt>
- `COPYING.RUNTIME.txt` (GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1)
  - <https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/master/COPYING.RUNTIME>
- `COPYING3.txt` (GNU GPL version 3)
  - <https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/master/COPYING3>
